arxiv-2009-02546.title: Dynamics of cellular flame deformation after a head-on interaction with a shock wave: reactive Richtmyer-Meshkov instability
arxiv-2009-02546.creator: Hongxia Yang 1,2, Matei Ioan Radulescu 2
arxiv-2009-02546.description: Abstract Shock flame interactions are fundamental problems in many combustion applications ranging from flame acceleration to flame control in supersonic propulsion applications. The present paper seeks to quantify the rate of deformation of the flame surface and burning velocity caused by the interaction and to clarify the underlying mechanisms.

arxiv-2212-00142.title: HUPD-2213 Determination of Majorana type-phases from the time evolution of lepton numbers
arxiv-2212-00142.creator: Nicholas J. Benoit 1 , Yuta Kawamura 3 , Saki Hamada 4 , Takuya Morozumi 1,2 , Yusuke Shimizu 5 , Kei Yamamoto 6 1 Physics Program Graduate School of Advanced Science and Engineering and 2 Core of Research for the Energetic Universe, Hiroshima University, Higashi-Hiroshima 739-8526, Japan 3 Kitakami
arxiv-2212-00142.description: Abstract We have investigated an approach for determining the Majorana type-phases using the time evolution of lepton family numbers. We show how the second-order time derivative of the expectation values for the lepton family numbers depends on the sum of the Majorana type-phases.

arxiv-2312-01184.title: Reynolds number required to accurately discriminate between trends of skin friction and streamwise peak intensities in wall turbulence
arxiv-2312-01184.creator: Hassan Nagib, Peter Monkewitz, Katepalli R. Sreenivasan
arxiv-2312-01184.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hassan Nagib, Peter Monkewitz, Katepalli R. Sreenivasan. We expand on the conclusion of Nagib, Chauhan & Monkewitz Nagib et al. 2007 that nearly all available skin friction relations for zero-pressure-gradient turbulent boundary layers come into remarkable agreement over the entire range R ​ e θ Re_{\theta} < < O( 10 8 10^{8} ), where R ​ e θ Re_{\theta} is the momentum thickness Reynolds number, provided one coefficient is adjusted in each relation by anchoring it to the most accurate measurements known.

arxiv-2401-07350.title: Electronic structure and magnetic correlations in trilayer nickelate superconductor La 4 Ni 3 O 10 under pressure
arxiv-2401-07350.creator: I. V. Leonov
arxiv-2401-07350.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by I. V. Leonov. It has been recently shown that under pressure trilayer Ruddlesden-Popper nickelate La 4 Ni 3 O 10 (LNO) becomes superconducting below a critical temperature ∼ \sim 20 K, in addition to the infinite-layer and bilayer systems. Motivated by this observation, we explore the effects of electron correlations on its electronic structure and magnetic properties using the advanced DFT+dynamical mean-field theory approach.

pmc-11927539.title: Conventional and drug‑eluting bead transarterial chemoembolization in patients with inoperable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: a meta‑analysis
pmc-11927539.creator: Su‑Rong Pan, Xue‑Wen Wo, Hong‑Fang Zhu, Feng‑Fei Xia
pmc-11927539.description: INTRODUCTIONIn patients with inoperable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICC), both conventional transarterial chemoembolization (cTACE) and drug‑eluting bead TACE (DEB‑TACE) can be employed as therapeutic interventions. However, the relative advantages of these strategies remain to be clarified.AIMThis meta‑analysis was performed to compare the safety and efficacy of DEB‑TACE and cTACE in the treatment of ICC.

pmc-12708616.title: Characteristics of the meibomian gland in a population without dry eye symptoms
pmc-12708616.creator: Sathiya Kengpunpanich, Pinnita Prabhasawat, Rawi Jongpipatchai, Chareenun Chirapapaisan, Panotsom Ngowyutagon, Wipawee Booranapong
pmc-12708616.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This cross-sectional study examined morphological and functional changes of the meibomian glands in 60 volunteers without dry eye symptoms, stratified into age groups of 31–40, 41–50, and 51–60 years. Participants were screened using the DEQS questionnaire (score ≤ 14) and underwent ocular assessments, including slit lamp examination, fluorescein tear breakup time (FTBUT), Schirmer test, lipid layer thickness (LLT), meibography, evaluation of meibomian gland expressibility, and meibum quality.

pmc-12974819.creator: Isabelle J. C. Dielwart, Daan Kremer, Tim J. Knobbe, Dion Groothof, Henri G. D. Leuvenink, Jenny E. Kootstra-Ros, Martin H. de Borst, Marco van Londen, Jan-Stephan F. Sanders, Robert A. Pol, Stephan J. L. Bakker, TransplantLines investigators
pmc-12974819.description: BackgroundDeceased donor kidney selection is largely determined by creatinine-based kidney function estimation. However, muscle wasting is common in potential donors and affects the accuracy of creatinine-based kidney function assessment. Cystatin C could serve as a muscle-mass independent alternative for this purpose.

pmc-13277955.title: Prospective, Double‐Blind, Vehicle‐Controlled Assessment of Topical Bakuchiol on Photoaging in a Chinese Population
pmc-13277955.creator: Zill‐e‐human Khan, Ratan K. Chaudhuri, Ajay Dulai, Anurag Tarmaster, Libing Pan, Raja K. Sivamani
pmc-13277955.description: BackgroundAging skin is a universal complaint among diverse patient populations. It encompasses physiologic changes to the skin, such as skin laxity, dyspigmentation, fine lines, and wrinkles. However, different populations may show different signs of aged skin. For example, Asian skin in particular exhibits stronger dyspigmentation in comparison to Caucasian skin.

pmc-13574973.title: A lightweight RPB-YOLO11-based detector improves mobile phenotyping of rice panicle blast
pmc-13574973.creator: Xuzhe Yang, Xinbo Zhao, Chenming Xu, Juntao Hu, Liang Xu, Jianan Chi, Nannan Zhang, Xianlong Wang, Leilei Liu, Bing Liu, Liang Tang, Weixing Cao, Yan Zhu, Zaiwen Feng, Liujun Xiao
pmc-13574973.description: Rice panicle blast detection is an important task in plant disease phenotyping. Field-based detection remains challenging because infected spike regions are often small, sparse, elongated, and affected by overlapping panicles, complex backgrounds, and variable illumination. In this study, we propose RPB-YOLO11, a lightweight YOLO11-based detector designed for rice panicle blast detection.

pmc-13669754.title: From cordoned consultations to cohesive care: A service evaluation of a one-stop, multi-speciality, hospice-based Duchenne muscular dystrophy clinic, UK
pmc-13669754.creator: Anna Mistry, Amanda Brain
pmc-13669754.description: BackgroundDuchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) is a multimorbid recessive genetic disorder. In 2020, a novel one-stop multi-disciplinary (MDT) DMD clinic was piloted in Jack’s Place Hospice (registered charity number 1002832), Winchester, UK. This service evaluation aimed to assess the level of National Neuroscience Advisory Group guideline adherence [NNAG, 2024], and the patient views of the clinic format.
